After 8 incredible years with the company, Sasha, our beloved Regional Manager, is moving on to an exciting new chapter in her career. To celebrate her immense contributions and bid her a heartfelt farewell, we’re hosting a special event in her honor. Join us for Sasha’s Farewell Celebration on December 14th, 2024, at 3:00 PM in the main conference room. This event will include speeches from key team members, a memory-sharing session, and a farewell toast. Sasha has played a crucial role in driving our regional success and has been a fantastic leader and mentor to many. Let’s gather to show our appreciation for her hard work, dedication, and the positive impact she’s had on all of us. Please RSVP by December 12th, and feel free to contribute to the group card or gift. Let’s make this a memorable send-off!
